Please provide a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature motivation.

## 🧪 Quality Assurance & Test Verification

Please verify each step before requesting review:
- [ ] `npm run lint` completes with zero TypeScript errors
- [ ] `npm run test` executes all unit and integration test suites cleanly
- [ ] `npm run build` compiles production bundles without missing dependencies
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or `.env` files are included in this PR

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🛡️ Security hardening or audit trail upgrade
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update or CI configuration
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization or bundle splitting
